result:
Build succeeded. The App shell (section 3) is implemented and the definition-of-done build passes.

Summary of what was added:
- `navigation/types.ts`, `navigation/RootNavigator.tsx` — React Navigation native-stack with `Home`, `Health`, `Transcribe` routes (added `@react-navigation/native`, `@react-navigation/native-stack`, `react-native-screens`, `react-native-safe-area-context` via `npx expo install`)
- `components/Button.tsx` — shared button supporting disabled state
- `screens/HomeScreen.tsx` — title/subtitle + Health/Transcribe navigation buttons
- `screens/HealthScreen.tsx`, `screens/TranscribeScreen.tsx` — static placeholders matching the exact labels in SPEC.md §3.2/3.3; back navigation comes from the stack's default header back button
- `App.tsx` — wraps the app in `NavigationContainer`

No native/platform calls were added — feature screens are inert placeholders as required for this phase.
